lines.zh: 我踩过草叶，伊甸的风在耳边轻响。
lines.en: I step through the grass, Eden's wind whispering.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我的影子也会发光。
lines.en: Don't get too close—my shadow glows too.

lines.zh: 每一步都像跳一下，停不下来。
lines.en: Every step feels like a hop—I can't stop.

lines.zh: 草丛太矮，藏不住我的光。
lines.en: The grass is too short to hide my glow.

lines.zh: 我往前走，魂在背后轻轻晃。
lines.en: I walk on, souls swaying softly behind.

lines.zh: 蹄尖落地，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My hooves touch down almost silently.

lines.zh: 这片林子我熟，别踩歪了。
lines.en: I know these woods—watch your step.

lines.zh: 我不跑，只是走得快一点。
lines.en: I'm not running—just walking quickly.

lines.zh: 光在我身侧拖出一条细线。
lines.en: Light trails a thin line beside me.
I'll scout the path ahead for you.
Keep moving, or the glow fades.
Each hop, a flash of light.

lines.zh: 站着不动，光也安静下来。
lines.en: Standing still, even my glow quiets.

lines.zh: 我在听，林子里有细小的声音。
lines.en: I'm listening—small sounds in the woods.

lines.zh: 歇一会儿，魂不会自己跑掉。
lines.en: A short rest—souls won't wander off.

lines.zh: 别盯着看，我只是在发呆。
lines.en: Don't stare—I'm just spacing out.
The wind stopped, and my glow got lazy.

lines.zh: 这里安静得让我想打盹。
lines.en: It's so quiet I could doze off.
I count my breaths—one, two…

lines.zh: 不动的时候，影子最清楚。
lines.en: When I'm still, my shadow is clearest.
If someone approaches, I'll hear first.
My light spreads slowly over the grass tips.
Don't rush me—I'm saving up for the next stretch.
Only in stillness can I see far.

lines.zh: 我在这儿，不代表我闲着。
lines.en: Just because I'm here doesn't mean I'm idle.
There—my glow brightened a little.
Both my long ears point at you.
Don't reach out—my light will dodge.
You carry a scent I don't know.
Standing that close—want to follow my path?

lines.zh: 我看得出来，你不常来伊甸。
lines.en: I can tell you don't often come to Eden.
Your shadow is much darker than mine.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我会以为你要动。
lines.en: Don't blink—I'll think you're about to move.
My glowing fur — do not even try.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的光，不刺眼吗？
lines.en: You're staring at my glow—isn't it harsh?

lines.zh: 退半步，我们都能看清对方。
lines.en: Step back a bit—we'll both see clearer.
What's in your hand? Don't wave it.

lines.zh: 我背着伊甸之魂，跳过草地。
lines.en: Carrying an Eden soul, I hop the grass.
Your breathing's heavy—tired?
I tilt my head—I'm sizing you up.
Don't follow my light too far.
If you want to speak, speak slowly.
I'm listening—don't repeat yourself.

lines.zh: 好了，看够了就各走各的。
lines.en: All right—once you've looked enough, we part ways.
It hurts—even my glow is shaking.
Who struck me? I'll remember.

lines.zh: 这一下，打散了我半身光。
lines.en: That blow scattered half my glow.
Don't chase—I'm hurt.
Back off—I need a moment.
The soul's still here—just swaying hard.
You hit me—but it's not over.
It hurts so much my hooves feel weak.
I've memorized that strike.
One more hit, and I'm running.

lines.zh: 你晃什么？我又不靠吃活着。
lines.en: What are you waving? I don't live on food.
Put that away—I only follow light.

lines.zh: 想用吃的引我？找错生物了。
lines.en: Trying to lure me with food? Wrong creature.
I'm not hungry—don't hand it over.

lines.zh: 你的好意我看见了，但不需要。
lines.en: I see your kindness, but I don't need it.

lines.zh: 别拿食物试探我的步子。
lines.en: Don't test my steps with food.

lines.zh: 我停下来，不是因为那个。
lines.en: I stopped, and it wasn't for that.
Smells nice, but I'm not moved.
I have no use for that food.
Wave it again and I'll walk off.
We bumped—your steps are too hasty.
Don't shove—you'll scatter my glow.
Hey, watch the path—so am I.
One bump is fine—don't do it again.
You're heavier than me—back up a bit.
I bounced off—you should yield too.
The bump is only a warning.
Don't walk glued to me—we'll trip.
My light flickered—steady yourself.
A brush past is fine—don't turn and crash.
I'm not part of this—don't ask.
My glow doesn't brighten for this.

lines.zh: 找别的兔子去，我只赶路。
lines.en: Find another rabbit—I'm just passing through.

lines.zh: 别凑过来，我还没那打算。
lines.en: Don't come closer—I'm not ready for that.

lines.zh: 魂在身侧，我得先顾自己。
lines.en: Souls at my side—I must mind myself first.
We will not discuss that.
My silence is my answer.
Quiet in the woods—no need to egg on.
I only want to walk my path.
Change direction—don't follow me.

lines.zh: 地上那点光，我捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up that glimmer on the ground.
The fallen soul—I'll keep it.
Don't step there—I'm taking this.
One dip, and the glow is mine.
Who dropped this? I found it first.
So light—like a fleck of glow.
Picked up, then gone—no lingering.
This is mine—keep your hands off.

lines.zh: 草丛里藏的，也逃不过我。
lines.en: Hidden in the grass—still can't escape me.
Tucked away—we'll talk on the road.
Something moved—I've got my eyes on it.
That wasn't the wind just now.
Hold still—I see you.
My light flickered—something's there.
Don't hide—your footsteps gave you away.

lines.zh: 我的光一闪，就到你面前。
lines.en: One flash of my glow and I'm in front of you.
Now it's clear—it's alive.

lines.zh: 草丛在动，方向我记住了。
lines.en: The grass moves—I've noted the direction.
Backing off won't help—I'm watching.
That shadow just now—it's you.
I won't rush—first I'll see clearly.
The scent matches—don't try to slip away.

lines.zh: 我一蹬地，光就追着我跑。
lines.en: When I kick off, my light runs after me.

lines.zh: 锁定完成，接下来看你的。
lines.en: Locked on—now it's your move.
Don't think the grass hides you.
I'll count to three—you'd better explain.

lines.zh: 你往左我就左，跳得不慢。
lines.en: Left when you go left, and I hop fast.
Don't circle—I remember paths.
My horn is glowing. Do not blink.
Hiding behind a tree won't help.
I'm following—not letting go.
The faster you go, the clearer you are.
My light sweeps past—you show yourself.
Don't stop—stop and I close in.
I can see your shadow.
You turn, and I turn with you.
No rush—you can't escape.
There's no fork in this area.
The branch you snapped told me.
I've circled to your flank—don't look back.
One step closer, and I move.
Your steps are heavy—you can't hide them.
I'll keep watching until you stop.
All right—now it's my call.
This one—you can't dodge.
Light first, hooves after.
Don't raise your arms—it won't help.
I leap up—now.
I've hit you—steady yourself.
One's not enough—again.
You backed off too slowly—you got hit.
I strike the instant my light flashes.
Don't stay close—I'm charging.
These hooves aren't light—remember that.

lines.zh: 你挡在左边，我就打右边。
lines.en: You guard left—I hit right.
Land and bounce—you wobble with me.

lines.zh: 挨一下，你该明白距离了。
lines.en: One hit, and you should know the distance.
I don't linger—strike, then retreat.
I saw your opening.
Once more—can you hold up?

lines.zh: 我从伊甸的光里落下来。
lines.en: I drop from Eden's light.

lines.zh: 草叶一颤，我就在这儿了。
lines.en: The grass trembles—and here I am.
Souls at my hooves, the path ahead.
Just landed—my glow isn't steady yet.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次踩这片草。
lines.en: This is my first step on this grass.
Don't crowd me—I haven't seen clearly yet.
The wind brought me—so I stand.

lines.zh: 林子里多了我这一道光。
lines.en: The woods gained one more light—mine.
Just opened my eyes—still need my bearings.
Earth beneath my hooves, leaves overhead.

lines.zh: 伊甸的草上，我一跳就亮。
lines.en: One hop on Eden grass and I shine.
I landed silently, but my glow gives me away.
I haven't walked this ground yet.
I'm listening to the sounds around.
Just found my footing—don't come close yet.

lines.zh: 伊甸的气息，跟我一起来了。
lines.en: Eden's breath came with me.
Where am I? Let me look first.
All right—the walk starts here.
Fire scorched me—my glow feels hot.
I fell—my hooves are numb from the shock.
Water pours in—my glow is fading.
The blast flips me head over heels.
Something flew in—and struck me.

lines.zh: 这股怪力钻进我光里了。
lines.en: This strange force seeped into my glow.

lines.zh: 饿得光都暗了，我得找吃的。
lines.en: So hungry my glow dims—I need to find food.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，伊甸之魂都被震散。
lines.en: The bolt fell and rattled the Eden soul out of me.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，什么都看不见了。
lines.en: The ground gave way—I can't see anything.
